title: Genetic Linkage Mapping of Co-Inherited Misaligned Behaviors

original_idea.body:
# Linkage Mapping of Co-Inherited Misaligned Behaviors

**Problem:** We lack a linkage map for which misaligned behaviors travel together.

**Direction:** Across many narrow fine-tunes, record a vector of misaligned-behavior measurements, compute pairwise co-occurrence to build a linkage map.

**Why it matters:** Fixing one linked behavior may fix many. Cheap LoRA.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2502.17424; arXiv:2506.11613.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Knowing which misaligned behaviors are linked informs efficient mitigation design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Many small LoRA fine-tunes plus correlation analysis; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused linkage-map but requires many fine-tunes and a behavior battery.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open organisms, public data; weak lab incentive on this mapping.

low_compute.reasoning: Many small LoRA fine-tunes plus inference on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Behavior clustering noted; a systematic linkage/co-occurrence map may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Behavior clustering noted; systematic linkage map may be open.
